svg.title: Agent Localization and Customization for Local BUs
svg.desc: A 4200 by 2000 transparent English-language diagram in a rose palette. The Group provides a versioned Domain Agent baseline with a nine-section definition, five business stages, eighteen reusable skills, guardrails and evaluation cases. A Local BU forks the baseline, retains its source version, and customizes six areas: business scope and outcomes; language and experience; products and knowledge; skills and workflows; systems, data and access; and authority and human oversight. The BU validates, approves, publishes and operates its own version. Group guardrails and local policies are enforced by runtime and business systems. Version lineage tracks source and local changes, reviews Group updates, and requires merge and re-test before publishing, with rollback available. The S15 Assemble Quote and Proposal example binds local products, an official quote system, templates and approvals, validates evidence, and releases local configuration with the BU Agent.
